# selects { #labdata.core.selects }

```python
labdata.core.selects(select, repo_key)
```

Test whether a narrowed scan should look at a repository.

The rule is the one [](`labdata.list`) filters with, so that narrowing a
rescan and narrowing a listing pick the same repositories: the text is
matched anywhere in ``owner/repo``, ignoring case. An owner alone is written
``owner/``, which cannot match a repository name.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**select**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Text to look for. `None` selects everything, which is what an ordinary scan does.

<code>[**repo_key**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The repository, as ``owner/repo``, or as its name alone where no owner is known.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Whether the repository is one to scan.
